details.acceptance: Pass after project.godot binds restart/reset/unstuck to physical F6, contains no restart binding on R, and a displaced/rotated live player resets through F6 to position (0,0.9,5.4), zero velocity, zero yaw/pitch, and captured input on two consecutive attempts. details.expected: FPS restart/reset/unstuck uses F6. Physical R remains exclusively available for reload and never resets the player.

measurements.expected: restart bound to F6; R unowned by restart
measurements.name: restart physical binding
measurements.observed: physical_keycode=82 (R); no F6 restart binding

measurements.expected: R does not reset player
measurements.name: R runtime response
measurements.observed: position (3.095344,0.9,1.205308), yaw -30.2522°, pitch 22.6891° reset to (0,0.9,5.4), yaw 0°, pitch 0°, velocity zero

details.observed: The candidate assigns restart to physical R. A matching physical-key black-box probe confirmed R invokes _reset_to_spawn(), restoring the spawn transform, initial camera orientation, zero velocity, and captured input. F6 has no owning restart binding.

Move and rotate until position, yaw, and pitch differ from spawn.
Inject physical R, matching the inspected physical-keycode-only binding, and observe the player reset to spawn.
Inspect project.godot [input]: restart uses physical_keycode 82 and has no F6 event.
retest_recipe: Change only the restart binding from physical R to physical F6; preserve _reset_to_spawn() restoration semantics.
Move and rotate away from spawn, inject physical F6 twice from separate displaced states, and bind before/after position, velocity, yaw, pitch, and mouse_captured.
Inject physical R and verify it does not reset or alter the player transform; retain R for the later reload action.

details.observed: The new authoritative controller resolves and commits controlled hits exactly once, but its damageable-hit branch never creates world-space impact feedback. The target only changes health, leaving the required impact part of the causal presentation chain absent.

Compare the hit frame with the blocked branch ownership: only blocked collisions create ShotImpact geometry.

Keep target damage exactly once and use the hit position, normal and surface/result to create one bounded world-space response.

Retest SEMI press-edge and AUTO hold/release cadence without changing the intact viewmodel package or accepted map.
